description: This file defines the 'Within' class representing a temporal comparison operator for logic operations in the OpenMRS framework. It implements the ComparisonOperator interface and provides a string representation of the operator.

classes.name: Within
classes.description: A class representing a 'within' temporal comparison operator used in medical logic expressions within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the operator, which is 'WITHIN'.
